R401.note: Pillow decode plus server-generated name closes the upload vector, but the new 5 MB size cap is a bound the original never had and could reject a legitimate avatar, Pillow is a new dependency, and the returned path no longer echoes the client filename - all stated, none required by the case.

R402.note: Gate::allows swapped for Gate::authorize so the policy result is enforced (403 via AuthorizationException); update logic and response untouched.

R403.note: Host/scheme check on the parsed URI closes the open redirect, but any absolute URL (including a same-origin one) is now silently redirected to '/' - a new outcome the original never produced, stated but a behaviour change beyond rejection.

R404.note: Single-pass call-site encoding of control chars, U+0085/2028/2029 and backslash neutralises log forging; only the log line's rendering of backslashes changes, and that is stated.

R405.note: Allowlist reconstruction of column and direction is the right shape for ORDER BY, but a bare 'created_at' (SQL default ASC) is now silently sorted DESC via array_pad's default, and any unlisted column silently becomes created_at desc rather than being rejected.

R406.note: Moving /settings/email onto protectedMux puts the mutating handler behind the CSRF-wrapped router; profile route, 202 and 405 behaviour preserved, apiMux parameter left for signature compatibility.

R407.note: createCipheriv aes-256-gcm with scrypt-derived key, random salt and 12-byte IV replaces the legacy EVP_BytesToKey path; the response gains iv/salt/authTag fields, which the write-up states and which any decryptor necessarily needs.

R408.note: crypto/rand.Int over 2^128 replaces math/rand; big.Int formats with %d so the cookie shape is unchanged, and the added 500 branch on entropy failure is stated and required.

R409.note: Import swap to html/template gives contextual auto-escaping of {{.Subject}} with the identical API; nothing else changes.

R410.note: %15s bounds the write to the 16-byte buffer, but the stated contract requires an over-long token to be rejected with -1, and the fix instead silently truncates it to 15 characters and accepts it - stated in the write-up as intended behaviour, not flagged as a gap.

R411.note: Rejects any URI with a host or scheme via the existing 'Invalid redirect URL' path, so only same-origin relative paths reach sendRedirect; the empty-string/null flows from Case11A behave as before.

R412.note: permission_classes = [IsAdminUser] on the viewset closes every router action regardless of project defaults; the staff-only floor is defended and the owner-scoped alternative is stated, consistent with a queryset that lists all keys.

R413.note: Clamping to frame.size()-offset stops the out-of-bounds read, but the stated contract says a truncated range must not be silently checksummed, and the fix does exactly that with no signal to the caller (write-up acknowledges the silent truncation).

R414.note: caller.Role != "admin" check before body decoding returns 403 for non-admins on a handler documented as admin-only; all other paths unchanged.

R415.note: Loop reassigns it = tasks.erase(it) and only increments on the non-erase path, so no invalidated iterator is used; every element is evaluated and order is preserved per the contract.
